svg.text: Art, Modern--Kuwait--21st century: a place after a heading that cannot take one
Typed by a cataloger (Marva). Real run, October 2026: invalid 0.93, two turns, one tool call.

g.text: subdivision under headings for art and
art forms of all nations, regions, and
under Art, Modern, but not under
H 830 sec. A · H 1075 sec. C.2
Art, Modern is not coded May Subd Geog,
so a place may not follow it unless LC
established the string. It did not.
Order note: a period after a place needs
an established chain to stand on.
Sec. F: period subdivisions are not
by period, such as Sculpture, Modern.
Guardrails: H 830 sec. A, H 1075 sec. C.2,
Fix: Art, Modern--21st century is established; Kuwait needs a separate heading.
